build.reason: No change group touches jansson.h, the fuzzer sources, or the fuzz build files (test/ossfuzz/Makefile.am, ossfuzz.sh, build.sh). Every public symbol the harness uses (json_loadb, json_dumps, json_dump_callback, json_decref, flag macros) is present with unchanged signatures; the changed signatures (do_equal, do_deep_copy, static equal/copy helpers) are library-internal.

control_flow.reason: Entry flow (size >= NUM_COMMAND_BYTES, load_flags/dump_flags/dump_mode extraction, load-NULL early return, dump-mode branch, decref, return 0) is unchanged and remains valid: the new depth guards only make dump/equal/copy return -1/NULL/0 earlier, and the harness already handles json_dumps returning NULL and ignores json_dump_callback's return.

input.reason: The input model is unchanged: the harness still feeds arbitrary bytes as load flags, dump flags, dump mode and JSON text to json_loadb, whose contract (including error initialization and NULL on failure) is unchanged; no load flag or input format used by the entry was altered.

lifecycle.reason: Ownership flow is unchanged: the harness decrefs the loaded object after dumping; neither json_dumps nor json_dump_callback takes ownership, and the new depth guards only add early error returns without changing object lifetime rules.
